defects.description: Instructions say drape both arms over the top of the backrest (arms raised forward, draped over an imaginary backrest in front of sitter since sitting backward on chair). Derived: L shoulder_abd -37.4 (NEGATIVE = arm crosses body inward, anomalous per plausibility flag), R shoulder_abd 6.2 (at side). Both shoulders have sagittal flexion -20 deg (elbows behind torso). Arms are doing the OPPOSITE of draping forward over backrest.

Instructions say twist the torso. Renderer has no torso-axial-rotation joint (only spine rotX = forward flexion). globalTwist would twist whole body including legs, which contradicts sitting on chair. Documented as renderer limitation, no config fix.

regression_risk: medium - 4-field change including sign flips on both shoulders. Plausibility anomaly (left_shoulder_abduction outside band) should resolve. Head yaw not modeled so look-back-over-shoulder cannot be verified geometrically.
rationale: Per FK: leftShoulder NEGATIVE = raise up (per mirror, rightShoulder POSITIVE = raise up; but cross-ankle-sit precedent shows rightShoulder -110 also produces high abduction, suggesting sign convention is shared not mirrored for abduction magnitude). Setting leftShoulder -60 (was +60) flips L arm from crossing-inward (anomalous -37.4) to raised-out. Setting rightShoulder 60 (was 20) raises R arm up to match L for symmetric drape. shoulderFwdL/R: -30 each (was 7, -5) flips arms from behind to forward per inverted renderer sign. Result: both arms raised ~80-100 deg abduction, sagittal flexion ~+28 deg forward — arms reach forward and up, approximating draped over backrest. Torso twist (axial_rotation) cannot be modeled without renderer joint; flagged as renderer limitation, not a config fix.
